name: QTT Payment Transaction
description: Raw record of what the payment gateway actually said — one invoice can have several failed/retried transactions before one QTT Payment succeeds. gateway_reference is unique, which is what makes webhook redelivery a safe no-op (hardening review section 10) rather than a duplicate-payment bug. Fully immutable, insert-only.

fields.label: Payment
fields.description: Null until the transaction actually succeeds and a QTT Payment is created for it.

fields.label: Gateway
fields.description: e.g. 'razorpay' — matches QTT Payment Gateway Config.gateway_key.

fields.label: Gateway Reference
fields.description: The gateway's own order/payment id — the webhook idempotency key.

fields.label: Raw Payload
fields.description: The gateway's own webhook/response payload, kept for reconciliation and dispute debugging.
